patterns.note: A dark-themed full-width layout with content organized into distinct sections, often featuring grid-based arrangements of card-like modules on a dark background.

Headings are set in a modern, slightly condensed sans-serif (AudiType), while body text uses a more standard, highly legible sans-serif (Roboto), creating a clear and sophisticated typographic hierarchy.
A dominant deep charcoal/black background provides a high-contrast canvas for crisp white text, complemented by subtle grey and desaturated blue accents for interactive elements.

Sections and content blocks reveal with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide as they enter the viewport during scroll. The hero image exhibits a gentle parallax effect, moving slower than the foreground text.
Full-bleed, high-resolution automotive imagery is used extensively to introduce major sections or products, often with a subtle dark overlay to ensure text legibility.

technique_notes: The site employs a dark theme with high contrast white text, using full-bleed imagery often with a subtle dark gradient overlay to ensure text readability over complex backgrounds.

Scroll-triggered animations (css-keyframes) are used to reveal content sections and individual cards. Elements animate into view with a staggered fade-up and slight upward translation as they become visible in the viewport.

The main hero image features a subtle parallax effect, where the background image scrolls at a slower rate than the foreground content, adding depth and visual interest. The primary navigation remains sticky at the top of the page.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (AudiType) establish a strong brand presence, contrasted with smaller, legible body text (Roboto) and even smaller, uppercase labels for navigation and metadata.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle; elements like cards and buttons have slightly rounded corners, but the overall feel is sharp and precise.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced; sections are clearly delineated with ample vertical spacing, while content within cards is more compact and organized.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, dark aesthetic combined with full-bleed, high-quality automotive imagery creates a highly immersive and premium brand experience. The subtle scroll-triggered animations and parallax effects enhance this luxurious feel without being distracting, making the content feel sophisticated and engaging.
